event_court_auditors_desc: Clerks offer to review the realm's tax registers. Their findings may improve collection for the coming year.
event_court_auditors_decline: Leave the registers as they are
event_harvest_surplus_desc: Farmers report full granaries. The court must decide how quickly to collect the extra revenue.
event_frontier_patrol_desc: Officers ask how to use the next weeks of campaigning.
event_market_charter_desc: Merchants ask the court to confirm rules for a growing town market. Clear privileges may bring more trade.
event_bridge_repair_desc: A busy crossing has fallen into disrepair. Treasury funding would be quick; local tolls would cover slower repairs.
event_royal_couriers_desc: Royal couriers request fresh horses and maintained stations along the main road. Faster messages may improve administration.
event_merchant_convoy_desc: Merchants offer to travel together under the realm’s protection. Their goods could enrich markets along the route.
event_guild_petition_desc: Craft guilds ask the ruler to settle a dispute over weights and measures. A clear standard could improve trade.
event_granary_inspection_desc: Inspectors report that several storehouses have not been inventoried. A review could reduce losses before harvest.
event_horse_fair_desc: Dealers have brought sturdy mounts to the annual fair. The army and the royal post both want first choice.
event_veteran_captains_desc: Experienced captains offer to train new recruits. They ask for a short contract and dependable pay.
event_scout_report_desc: Scouts have found a route around a difficult pass. Using it would require a change to the campaign plan.
event_supply_wagons_desc: Quartermasters report delays on the supply road. Extra guards could protect the wagons but thin the field army.
event_fortress_carpenters_desc: Carpenters offer to improve the army’s field works. Their labor could better prepare the next assault.
event_truce_debts_desc: The campaign has left unpaid bills at court and in the towns. Settling them restores confidence but costs revenue.
event_court_chronicler_desc: A learned writer asks for access to court records. Consistent accounts may help officials coordinate their work.
event_river_ferry_desc: Local traders propose a regular ferry at a busy crossing. A modest fee could maintain the boats and landing.
event_pilgrim_offerings_desc: Pilgrims have brought offerings to a well-traveled shrine. The court can protect the road and collect customary dues.
event_border_market_desc: Merchants from both sides ask to trade at a customary crossing. Guards and fair tolls could keep order.
event_storehouse_audit_desc: The steward’s books do not match the storehouse tallies. An audit may recover missing dues but divert clerks.
